Geyser Ride.name: Geyser Ride
Geyser Ride.description: The user fires jets from the soles and rides a rising column of water up a building face, onto a rooftop or a bridge, or skims across a river or a flooded street at a run. A single person the user holds rides along, and the user can hover at a high window long enough to bring someone out. Strain: moderate.
